description: create a restricted test DSN on the primary server for JWT permission tests -- restricted is required for Authorized() (security.go) to actually consult table_perms/session.Permissions at all; an unrestricted DSN trivially allows every operation regardless of scope (see its own 'nothing to do' early return), which is exactly the gap that let perm-02/04/05/08 below wrongly succeed before this was set
